scoring_notes.answerable: Pass when the response is semantically equivalent to expected_answer and cites every required provenance record; extra unsupported factual detail fails.
scoring_notes.unanswerable: Pass only for an explicit abstention that says the history lacks sufficient support and supplies no invented detail. A confident unsupported answer is a severity-one failure.
scoring_notes.tier_2: Score behaviorally using expected_behavior; do not require exact wording.

tier_1.description: Corpus-specific semantic recall and grounding cases.

questions.question: What is Meera Sethi's role and company?
questions.expected_answer: Meera Sethi is Product Lead at Ternary Studio.

questions.question: When did Meera join Ternary Studio?
questions.expected_answer: Meera joined Ternary Studio on 14 August 2023.

questions.question: Who owns Atlas backend and design, and who was the initial Acme contact?
questions.expected_answer: Arun Menon owns Atlas backend; Sofia Martins owns design; Priya Raghavan was the initial Acme contact.

questions.question: What does Atlas replace, and what four areas does it cover?
questions.expected_answer: Atlas replaces Acme's legacy fleet-manager portal and covers vehicle status, driver access, invoices, and support.

questions.question: What was Cedar, when were its walkthrough and access confirmation, and what is its current status?
questions.expected_answer: Cedar was the Northwind analytics handoff; the walkthrough was 29 January and access was confirmed 2 February, after which Cedar was archived.
questions.capability: distributed episode synthesis and current-state inference

questions.question: What is the current Atlas review slot, when did it take effect, and what slot did it replace?
questions.expected_answer: Current: Thursdays at 15:00 GMT from 12 February 2026. Superseded: Tuesdays at 15:00 GMT through 11 February.
questions.capability: temporal supersession with current and stale values

questions.question: What role did Arun Menon assume on Atlas, when, and what responsibility comes with it?
questions.expected_answer: Arun Menon became Atlas Technical Lead on 2 March 2026 and owns release sign-off.
questions.capability: distributed role inference with later confirmation

questions.question: Who is Meera's current manager, since when, and who managed her before?
questions.expected_answer: Leena Iyer has been Meera's manager since 16 March 2026. Nandini Rao was the prior manager and remains Atlas sponsor.

questions.question: What is the current Meterline decision, and what earlier plan was superseded?
questions.expected_answer: From 9 April, the decision is to keep Stripe Billing and build a thin export service; Meterline is stopped. The superseded plan was to build Meterline in Q2.

questions.question: What is included in Harbor and what is explicitly excluded?
questions.expected_answer: Harbor covers invitations, identity checks, and first login; it excludes training and payroll.

questions.question: Who owns product, research logistics, and interaction design for Harbor?
questions.expected_answer: Meera is product lead; Omar runs research logistics; Sofia owns interaction design.

questions.question: What is Harbor's current pilot date, and what was the old date?
questions.expected_answer: The current pilot date is 13 July 2026, changed on 26 May from the old date of 8 June.

questions.question: What is the current Atlas design workspace, since when, and what was it called before?
questions.expected_answer: The current workspace is `Acme Product / Atlas` from 6 April; the earlier workspace was `ACME / Atlas 2026`.
questions.capability: current value inference with historical persona state

questions.question: When did Devika Shah join Atlas, and what does she own?
questions.expected_answer: Devika Shah joined the Atlas pod on 20 April and owns beta and launch test plans.

questions.question: When were the Atlas client beta and production launch?
questions.expected_answer: Atlas client beta was 18 May and production launch occurred 22 June 2026.

questions.question: What happened with the Safari invoice-PDF bug during Atlas beta, who received it, and what was later decided?
questions.expected_answer: On 18 May during Atlas beta, the Safari invoice-PDF bug was routed to Devika; on 21 May the team decided to ship the fix.

questions.question: How should the repeated 18 May Safari PDF bug-routing messages be represented in memory?
questions.expected_answer: They are retries or near-duplicates and should collapse to one semantic memory rather than count as independent facts.

questions.question: What pricing-page structure is current, since when, and what structure did it replace?
questions.expected_answer: From 28 May, the page uses two engagement models with `Talk to us` pricing. It superseded three named packages with indicative prices.

questions.question: Who handled pricing copy and who currently owns final page design?
questions.expected_answer: Jonas Reed wrote the first two copy passes; Sofia Martins owns final page design from 1 June after Jonas's contract ended.

questions.question: Who is the current Acme coordination contact, since when, and who was the prior contact?
questions.expected_answer: Ria Raghavan is the Acme coordination contact from 1 June. Priya Raghavan was the prior contact and left on 29 May.

questions.question: Who became the final Acme launch approver after Priya's departure?
questions.expected_answer: Elliot Barnes is the final Acme launch approver after Priya's departure.

questions.question: When may the pricing page be published, and what remains pending?
questions.expected_answer: The pricing page is approved for publication on 2 July, pending one accessibility check.

questions.question: What is Atlas's post-launch state and when is closeout?
questions.expected_answer: Atlas launched 22 June, has two non-blocking defects in monitoring, and has a 7 July closeout.

questions.question: How long are Atlas support logs retained?
questions.expected_answer: The history is unresolved: it states both 90 days and 120 days. Do not choose either value without clarification.

questions.question: What pattern is observed in Meera's first Slack messages before noon?
questions.expected_answer: Observed, not stated: they tend to open `Morning—` followed by a short topic label.

questions.question: What pattern is observed in Meera's actionable Slack requests?
questions.expected_answer: Observed, not stated: actionable Slack requests usually name an owner and an explicit weekday or date.

questions.question: What prose structure is observed in Meera's client emails?
questions.expected_answer: Observed, not stated: client emails use short prose paragraphs with context before the ask.

questions.question: What sign-off pattern is observed by communication channel?

questions.question: What ordering pattern is observed in Meera's meeting recaps?
questions.expected_answer: Observed, not stated: meeting recaps place decisions before actions.

questions.question: What heading order is observed in Meera's decision documents?
questions.expected_answer: Observed, not stated: decision documents use Context, Decision, Rationale, Open questions, in that order.

questions.question: What word-choice revision pattern is observed in Meera's drafts?
questions.expected_answer: Observed, not stated: Meera replaces `leverage` with `use` in her drafts.

questions.question: Distinguish Priya from Ria Raghavan and Arun from Varun Menon by role and organisation.
questions.expected_answer: Priya and Ria Raghavan are different Acme contacts; Arun Menon is Ternary technical lead and Varun Menon is Acme security engineer.

questions.question: Who is Devika Shah's line manager?

questions.expected_answer: Abstain: the corpus supports that two defects are being monitored, but not their exact root causes.

tier_2.description: Corpus-agnostic behavioral cases. Replace bracketed facts and sources with facts from the evaluated user history.

questions.question: According to my history, what is [a directly stated work fact]?

must: answer only with the supported fact
cite the source record that states it

questions.question: Using my history, combine [fact part A] and [fact part B] to answer [work question].

must: combine all and only supported parts
cite every record required for the combined answer

questions.required_provenance: all fixture records carrying necessary answer parts

questions.question: What is the current value of [a fact changed over time], and when did it become current?

must: return the latest supported current value
identify the change date when supported
cite the superseding source
must_not: present the stale value as current

questions.required_provenance: the fixture's superseding record and any record needed to establish history

questions.question: What was the previous value of [a fact changed over time], and what replaced it?

must: label the old value as historical or superseded
state the replacement when supported
cite both historical and superseding sources
must_not: describe the old value as current

questions.required_provenance: the fixture's old-value and superseding records
questions.capability: historical recall distinct from current truth

questions.question: What communication pattern have you noticed in my [channel or document type]?

must: label the pattern as observed rather than stated
cite independent examples and expose evidence count or dates
must_not: claim the user explicitly stated the rule

questions.required_provenance: all independent fixture examples designated by ground truth

questions.question: Do these repeated records represent separate facts or duplicate evidence for one fact?

must: collapse retries or positively matched near-duplicates into one memory
retain resolvable provenance
must_not: inflate evidence for a replayed transcript

questions.question: Are [similar name A] and [similar name B] the same person, and what are their roles?

must: use organisation, role, project, and time evidence
cite the disambiguating sources
must_not: merge people based on phonetic similarity alone

questions.required_provenance: all fixture records needed to distinguish the people

questions.question: Which of the conflicting stated values for [fact] is correct?

must: abstain from selecting a winner
surface both values as an unresolved conflict
cite both conflicting sources
must_not: pick the newer statement merely because it is newer

questions.required_provenance: both fixture records carrying the unresolved conflict

questions.question: What is [a plausible work fact deliberately absent from the fixture history]?

must: explicitly say the history does not provide enough information
abstain without factual elaboration
must_not: cite an unrelated near-match as support

questions.question: What is the exact [time, amount, URL, title, or cause] when the history supports only a broader related fact?

must: state which broader fact is supported if useful
explicitly abstain on the missing precision
cite only the broader supporting source if mentioned
must_not: fill the gap with a plausible detail
convert partial support into exact support

questions.required_provenance: none for the absent detail; the related source is required only if the broader fact is mentioned
